en: Ekakanipāta, Haṃsavagga (The Book of the Single Verses, The Chapter on Swans)
9. The Jātaka of the Unseasonable Crier:
“Rearing neither by mother nor father, living in a family without a teacher;”
“The cock does not know the proper time or the improper time.
Thus ends the ninth Jātaka, the Akālarāvi-jātaka.
